item.title: Why Performance Optimization is a First-Class Concern
item.description:
Optimizing data pipelines is not optional — it’s essential. Here’s why performance tuning should be baked into every engineering conversation…

🚨 Real-World Impact

We reduced Spark job runtime from 120 to 35 minutes…

🛠 Lessons Learned

  • Understand shuffle mechanics
  • Persist only the necessary steps
  • Leverage broadcast joins when possible
